commits.message:
feat(widgets): re-export the TextInput wrap strategies from the package root (rich-docs-vk9.6) (#67)

`WrapStrategy`, `WrapRow`, and `charGreedyWrap` were declared in
`src/widgets/text-input.ts` and exported from neither barrel, so a consumer
of the published package could reach `TextInput`'s `wrap` option only by
writing a strategy from scratch — the one the library already ships was
unreachable, and a caller could not annotate their own strategy with the
type it has to satisfy.

The symptom was visible in-repo: `examples/rich-template-bindings/app.ts`
imported the two types through `../../src/widgets/text-input.js`, a lone
deep path sitting under a 22-symbol barrel import. That line now folds into
the barrel import and is gone.

`charGreedyWrap` is covered by use rather than by an allowlist entry. The
demo's `templateAtomWrap` hand-rolled char-greedy wrapping for the
too-wide-tag case — `cellFit` plus a force-take-one-code-point guard, which
is `charGreedyWrap`'s exact contract — so that branch now delegates to the
built-in. A differential run over 8064 (tag, firstWidth, continuationWidth,
isFirst) combinations for budgets 1..24 shows zero divergence from the
previous implementation.

Verified: `npm run lint`, `npx vitest run` (1766 passed — the coverage suite
is the gate here), `npm run docs:build`, `npm run demos:build`. The coverage
gate was also run against the known violation — barrel exports added, demo
reference removed — and fails on exactly `charGreedyWrap`, confirming the
demo reference is what covers it and that the two types were already covered
via the demo's pre-existing import.
